body.text: Lumen Archive is an online archive workshop. Participants must be at least 15 years old. Participants younger than 18 must have guardian consent. Each participant must also be a resident, a member, a student, or at least 25 years old. Registration must be submitted strictly before 2033-05-14T18:30:00.000Z. All admission requirements apply even to scholarship holders. For eligible participants, charge the first matching fee in this order: scholarship holders aged 19 or younger pay $6; members pay $11; students pay $15; residents pay $21; everyone else pays $29. All amounts are USD. These fees do not combine.
